description: We are a team of three students passionate about space, coding, and design. Excited to create an awesome project for NASA Space
summary:
Our Mission & Why We Created It
Space Penguins was built to transform complex space engineering and resource management into an exciting, hands-on learning adventure. We created it to spark curiosity in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) by putting players right in the captain's chair of a lunar outpost.

How It Helps Young Explorers
The game teaches critical thinking, quick decision-making, and resource balancing by forcing commanders to weigh daily trade-offs between energy, oxygen, water, and radiation shielding.

Real-World Problem Solving
Just like real space missions, every choice matters. Players learn how fragile life support systems are, how to adapt during unexpected crises (like meteorite impacts), and how teamwork and engineering logic keep a crew alive.
details:
​1. What it does & how it works:

Lunar Outpost is a fast-paced survival game where players manage a moon base over a 10-day mission with a 15-minute real-time clock. Players press a base button daily to trigger engineering trade-offs, adjusting life support, radiation shielding, power, and food production to keep every resource above 0%.

​2. Benefits:

It sharpens fast decision-making and strategic thinking while giving players a realistic glimpse into aerospace engineering challenges and resource balancing under pressure.

​3. Intended Impact:

To spark interest in space exploration, STEM, and systems engineering by making complex space-survival problems interactive and fun.

​4. Tools & Technologies:

​Languages: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3

​Tools & Design: Visual Studio Code, GitHub, and Gemini for creating pictures

​5. Creativity:

Translates real space hazards (cosmic radiation, power drops) into intense, dynamic game mechanics where daily event trade-offs create unique gameplay every run.

​6. Key Considerations:

​Game Balance: Tuning the 15-minute timer so it feels tense but fair.

​Clear UI: Designing an intuitive dashboard for split-second status checks.

​Realism vs. Fun: Simplification of complex lunar physics into readable, engaging gameplay.
